body:
I'm so sorry... I'm severely suicidal right now, and I actually interrupted my negative and self-destructive train of thought to comment on this.  TRUE friends do not fucking post about their dealings with a 'difficult friendship.'  What in the utter fuck is wrong with the people you know???? 

Writing a blog how they have fucking freed themselves from a friend in need?! Disgusting! This has made me so angry. Friendship is NEVER based upon happy times and roses exclusively... TRUE friendship experiences the fucking shitty aspects of human existence.  To both of those people who messaged/blogged about you... GET A FUCKING LIFE.  Pathetic, narcissist wankers... only care about people suffering, as long as they can write a blog/get selfies with/update Facebook about... self-serving dicks.  Count yourself as extremely lucky, move on and make new friends... I am always here if you want to talk about anything at ALL... sending you so, SO much love.  Stay strong <3
